mapper.sql: i.id, w.company_id, d.dept_name AS company_name, i.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, l.zone_id, z.zone_name, i.location_id, l.location_code, l.location_name, i.material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.specification, m.model, m.category_id, c.category_name, m.base_unit_id, u.unit_name AS base_unit_name, u.symbol AS base_unit_symbol, i.quantity, i.locked_quantity, (i.quantity - i.locked_quantity) AS available_quantity, m.safety_stock, i.version

FROM wm_inventory i INNER JOIN wm_warehouse w ON w.id = i.warehouse_id AND w.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN wm_warehouse_location l ON l.id = i.location_id AND l.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN wm_warehouse_zone z ON z.id = l.zone_id AND z.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN wm_material m ON m.id = i.material_id AND m.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN wm_material_category c ON c.id = m.category_id AND c.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN wm_unit u ON u.id = m.base_unit_id AND u.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = w.company_id AND d.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY w.warehouse_name, l.location_code, m.material_code, i.id

SELECT
ORDER BY w.warehouse_name, l.location_code, m.material_code, i.id

SELECT w.company_id, d.dept_name AS company_name, i.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, i.material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.specification, m.model, m.category_id, c.category_name, u.unit_name AS base_unit_name, u.symbol AS base_unit_symbol, SUM(i.quantity) AS quantity, SUM(i.locked_quantity) AS locked_quantity, SUM(i.quantity) - SUM(i.locked_quantity) AS available_quantity, m.safety_stock, CASE WHEN m.safety_stock > 0 AND SUM(i.quantity) - SUM(i.locked_quantity) < m.safety_stock THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS low_stock
GROUP BY w.company_id, d.dept_name, i.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, i.material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.specification, m.model, m.category_id, c.category_name, u.unit_name, u.symbol, m.safety_stock
HAVING m.safety_stock > 0 AND SUM(i.quantity) - SUM(i.locked_quantity) < m.safety_stock
ORDER BY w.warehouse_name, m.material_code, i.material_id
